firm_data.firm_description: Feldman Kieffer is a New York law firm with longstanding offices in the markets that matter today. They offer innovative solutions to challenging situations and represent clients throughout New York.
notable_facts: Included in Martindale Hubbell’s exclusive Bar Register of Preeminent Lawyers

email.subject: AI for Feldman Kieffer, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Adam,

Feldman Kieffer's recognition in Martindale Hubbell's exclusive Bar Register of Preeminent Lawyers reflects the caliber of work your team delivers across complex areas like Environmental and Toxic Tort litigation. That level of quality demands precision and efficiency, especially when competing on scope.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Buffalo to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
